order: Carry the in-progress rename of the plan roundabout from its old name to deep-plan out of the working tree into this commit, complete and self-consistent across the harness. Rename the roundabout hook file and convert everything it carries, from its header and usage text through its environment-variable names, the engine header line, the unavailable verdict token, the saved-response temporary-directory prefix, and every prose mention. Rename the skill directory and update its frontmatter name and description, its headings, the runner path, its verdict token, and the log heading. Point the installer at the new runner filename in the runner constant, the install-time copy, and the uninstall list. Update the planner agent file, the orchestration document, and the README end to end. Update the bundled-skill roster in the status skill so a status run names deep-plan and never the old name. Behavior must stay unchanged; this is a rename plus its documentation sync, kept as its own commit.
claims: The rename landed across the harness, with the roundabout hook file and every identifier it carried moved over, along with the skill directory, its frontmatter, headings and verdict token; the installer copies and uninstalls the new filename; and the planner agent file, the orchestration document and the README converted. The bundled-skill roster in the status skill now names deep-plan. A case-insensitive repository-wide grep for the old name returns 0 matches at head, and the installer run lists deep-plan among the bundled skills.
